args.body:
Summary of websites shared in #general:

• www.informations.com — A news article covering the latest job report, which brought a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

• www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, renowned for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional Swiss dishes such as cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert. Warm wooden interiors decorated with Swiss memorabilia create a welcoming, rustic atmosphere, and large windows offer stunning panoramic views of the city skyline. Friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire make each visit feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! I just had a look at your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean introduction — I like that it keeps things simple and personal, and it's easy to find your contact details. A couple of suggestions if you'd like to make it even better: adding a bit more about your interests, work, or projects would give visitors a better sense of who you are, and a few links to your other profiles or work samples would make it more engaging. Overall, a solid personal site — keep it up!

Hi Eve! I read through your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and it was a pleasure to browse. I especially liked learning that hiking is your favorite hobby — it gives a really nice personal touch to the blog and hints at plenty of great material to write about. If you're looking to grow it, adding some photos or trip stories from your hikes, plus a few recent posts with dates, would make it easier for readers to follow along and come back for more. Great blog — I'd love to read more about your adventures!
